title: 58% of first-time buyers believe debt blocks mortgage access
summary:
Almost three out of five first-time buyers believe that having existing debt will prevent them from obtaining a mortgage, according to new research from Lloyds. The survey of 1,000 prospective buyers found that 58% thought any borrowing would block mortgage approval, while 37% believed a 20% deposit was essential to secure lending.

title: Centrick appointed to Crest Nicholson’s managing agent framework
summary:
Property management firm Centrick has been appointed to Crest Nicholson's managing agent competency framework, allowing the company to tender for residential development management contracts across the housebuilder's portfolio. The appointment follows an assessment of Centrick's operations, processes and capabilities.

title: Inflation rises to 2.9% raising mortgage rate concerns
summary:
UK inflation increased to 2.9% in July, up from 2.6% in June, according to Office for National Statistics data. The rise above the Bank of England's 2% target could delay anticipated interest rate cuts and maintain higher borrowing costs for property buyers.

title: £8.5m bridge loan backs West London care home refinance
summary:
United Trust Bank has provided an £8.5 million commercial sales bridge facility to support the refinancing of a care home development site in West London. The completed project is expected to achieve a gross development value of £65 million.

title: Willmotts moves sales division to eXp UK network
summary:
Willmotts has transferred its residential sales operation to eXp UK's platform, providing access to a network of more than 1,000 agents across the country. The move follows similar platform adoption by Essex agency NAKED in recent weeks.

The post Willmotts moves sales division to eXp UK network appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Conveyancing fees decline in real terms amid market pressure
summary:
Conveyancing fees have declined in real terms over the past year, adding pressure on firms already contending with reduced housing market activity and competitive pricing. The average cost of conveyancing for a home mover buying and selling a property reached £2,438 including VAT in the second quarter of 2026, rising just 0.1% year-on-year compared with CPI inflation of 2.6%.

title: Skipton International adds limited company BTL for expats
summary:
Skipton International has introduced limited company buy-to-let mortgages for non-UK resident landlords purchasing or refinancing UK property through special purpose vehicles. The product targets eligible expat and international investors operating through SPV structures, with loans available up to 65% loan-to-value.

title: Knight Frank expands London affiliate broker network
summary:
Knight Frank has appointed four brokers to its London affiliate network as part of the second phase of recruitment for its self-employed broker model. Cameron Forbes, Ella Coates, Josh Collins and Salil Joshi have taken responsibility for territories across West, South West and North London.

title: New-build asking prices rise 0.2% amid regional disparities
summary:
Average asking prices for newly instructed new-build properties in Britain increased 0.2% to £501,658 in July 2026, though regional variations show the West Midlands up 8.8% whilst the East of England fell 3.5%.

title: Purplebricks founder takes significant stake in firm
summary:
Companies House filings have confirmed that Purplebricks founder Michael Bruce has acquired a significant stake in the online estate agency. Bruce now owns between 25% and 50% of the company's equity following his return as director in June.
